schools_mapped.label: Schools mapped
schools_mapped.definition: Schools in schools.csv, every one carrying a coordinate.

schools_elementary.label: Elementary schools mapped
schools_elementary.definition: Schools whose layer is cps_elem or charter_elem.

schools_high.label: High schools mapped
schools_high.definition: Schools whose layer is cps_high or charter_high.

schools_other.label: Options and alternative schools mapped
schools_other.definition: Schools whose layer is other_alt: the contract, ALOP and SAFE schools.

schools_placed_in_building.label: Schools placed inside their building
schools_placed_in_building.definition: Schools whose match_quality asserts a building (address_exact or containing).

libraries.label: Library branches
libraries.definition: Chicago Public Library branches in libraries.csv.

libraries_placed_in_building.label: Branches placed inside their building
libraries_placed_in_building.definition: Branches whose match_quality is address_exact, library_named or containing.

park_buildings.label: Park District buildings
park_buildings.definition: Buildings in the Chicago Park District inventory.

health_clinics.label: CDPH clinics on the 2016 roster
health_clinics.definition: Clinics on CDPH's clinic-locations roster, current as of June 2016.

mental_health_clinics_2016.label: Mental health clinics on CDPH's 2016 roster

senior_centers.label: Senior centers
senior_centers.definition: DFSS senior centers on the 2011 roster.

workforce_centers.label: Workforce centers
workforce_centers.definition: DFSS workforce centers on the 2011 roster.

city_service_sites.label: City service sites
city_service_sites.definition: CDPH clinics, DFSS senior centers and DFSS workforce centers together (health_clinics.csv, senior_centers.csv, workforce_centers.csv).

cdph_mental_health_centers.label: CDPH mental health centers, 2026
cdph_mental_health_centers.definition: The mental health centers CDPH listed on its website on 2026-09-21.

utilization_records.label: School records with a utilization row
utilization_records.definition: Rows of utilization.csv for SY2026; one row is one school, not one building.

scored_records.label: School records with a space-use status
scored_records.definition: Utilization rows whose cps_status is Underutilized, Efficient or Overcrowded.

scored_buildings.label: Buildings with a space-use status
scored_buildings.definition: Distinct school addresses among the scored records; 5 addresses carry two scored schools.

underutilized_records.label: Underutilized school records
underutilized_records.definition: Utilization rows whose cps_status is Underutilized: below 70 percent of adjusted ideal capacity.

underutilized_buildings.label: Underutilized buildings
underutilized_buildings.definition: Distinct school addresses among the underutilized records; 2400 S Marshall Blvd carries two.

empty_seats_underutilized.label: Empty seats in underutilized buildings
empty_seats_underutilized.definition: Adjusted ideal capacity minus utilization enrollment, summed over the underutilized records.

spare_classrooms_underutilized.label: Spare classroom-equivalents in underutilized buildings
spare_classrooms_underutilized.definition: Homerooms less the homerooms the utilization enrollment needs at 28 (elementary) or 30 (high school) students, divided by 0.77 or 0.8 homerooms per classroom, summed over the underutilized records.

district_utilization.label: Districtwide utilization
district_utilization.definition: Utilization enrollment summed over the 496 scored records divided by their summed adjusted ideal capacity: the aggregate ratio, not the mean of building rates.

students_underutilized.label: Students in underutilized buildings
students_underutilized.definition: 20th-day enrollment summed over the underutilized records.

students_underutilized_no_center.label: Students in underutilized buildings with no health center
students_underutilized_no_center.definition: 20th-day enrollment summed over underutilized records whose school hosts no operating in-building health center.

underutilized_buildings_austin.label: Underutilized buildings, Austin
underutilized_buildings_austin.definition: Underutilized buildings whose community area is Austin, the schools.csv community of the address.

underutilized_buildings_south_lawndale.label: Underutilized buildings, South Lawndale
underutilized_buildings_south_lawndale.definition: Underutilized buildings whose community area is South Lawndale, the schools.csv community of the address.

underutilized_buildings_north_lawndale.label: Underutilized buildings, North Lawndale
underutilized_buildings_north_lawndale.definition: Underutilized buildings whose community area is North Lawndale, the schools.csv community of the address.

underutilized_buildings_west_town.label: Underutilized buildings, West Town
underutilized_buildings_west_town.definition: Underutilized buildings whose community area is West Town, the schools.csv community of the address.

underutilized_buildings_englewood.label: Underutilized buildings, Englewood
underutilized_buildings_englewood.definition: Underutilized buildings whose community area is Englewood, the schools.csv community of the address.

underutilized_buildings_east_garfield_pa.label: Underutilized buildings, East Garfield Park
underutilized_buildings_east_garfield_pa.definition: Underutilized buildings whose community area is East Garfield Park, the schools.csv community of the address.

underutilized_buildings_roseland.label: Underutilized buildings, Roseland
underutilized_buildings_roseland.definition: Underutilized buildings whose community area is Roseland, the schools.csv community of the address.

underutilized_buildings_new_city.label: Underutilized buildings, New City
underutilized_buildings_new_city.definition: Underutilized buildings whose community area is New City, the schools.csv community of the address.

underutilized_buildings_auburn_gresham.label: Underutilized buildings, Auburn Gresham
underutilized_buildings_auburn_gresham.definition: Underutilized buildings whose community area is Auburn Gresham, the schools.csv community of the address.

underutilized_buildings_lower_west_side.label: Underutilized buildings, Lower West Side
underutilized_buildings_lower_west_side.definition: Underutilized buildings whose community area is Lower West Side, the schools.csv community of the address.

underutilized_buildings_leased.label: Underutilized buildings with leased classrooms
underutilized_buildings_leased.definition: Underutilized buildings with a record whose classrooms_leased is above zero.

underutilized_six_spare.label: Underutilized buildings with six or more spare classrooms
underutilized_six_spare.definition: Underutilized buildings whose spare classroom-equivalents, summed over the records at the address, reach 6.

six_spare_median_enrollment.label: Median enrollment of buildings with six spare classrooms
six_spare_median_enrollment.definition: Median of 20th-day enrollment, summed per building, over the 255 buildings with six or more spare classrooms.

six_spare_500_students.label: Buildings with six spare classrooms and 500 or more students
six_spare_500_students.definition: Underutilized buildings with six or more spare classrooms whose summed 20th-day enrollment is 500 or more.

six_spare_400_students.label: Buildings with six spare classrooms and 400 or more students
six_spare_400_students.definition: Underutilized buildings with six or more spare classrooms whose summed 20th-day enrollment is 400 or more.

six_spare_600_students.label: Buildings with six spare classrooms and 600 or more students
six_spare_600_students.definition: Underutilized buildings with six or more spare classrooms whose summed 20th-day enrollment is 600 or more.

hs_scored.label: High schools with a space-use status
hs_scored.definition: Scored records whose grade_category is HS.

hs_underutilized.label: Underutilized high schools
hs_underutilized.definition: Scored HS records whose cps_status is Underutilized.

hs_underutilized_median_enrollment.label: Median enrollment of underutilized high schools
hs_underutilized_median_enrollment.definition: Median 20th-day enrollment over the 44 underutilized high schools.

hs_underutilized_under_300.label: Underutilized high schools under 300 students
hs_underutilized_under_300.definition: Underutilized high schools whose 20th-day enrollment is below 300.

hs_underutilized_below_30pct.label: Underutilized high schools below 30 percent of capacity
hs_underutilized_below_30pct.definition: Underutilized high schools whose utilization enrollment divided by adjusted ideal capacity is below 0.30 (the ratio, not the rounded su_pct).

es_seats_per_homeroom.label: Elementary seats per homeroom
es_seats_per_homeroom.definition: CPS's Space Utilization Methodology SY26 rule, asserted against every workbook row by the build.

hs_seats_per_homeroom.label: High-school seats per homeroom
hs_seats_per_homeroom.definition: CPS's Space Utilization Methodology SY26 rule, asserted against every workbook row by the build.

es_homeroom_share.label: Elementary homerooms per adjusted classroom
es_homeroom_share.definition: CPS's SY26 rule: elementary homerooms are the floor of adjusted classrooms times this share.

hs_homeroom_share.label: High-school homerooms per adjusted classroom
hs_homeroom_share.definition: CPS's SY26 rule: high-school homerooms are adjusted classrooms times this share.

underutilized_threshold.label: Underutilized threshold
underutilized_threshold.definition: CPS labels a building underutilized below 70 percent of adjusted ideal capacity; checked against the status bands in utilization.csv.

overcrowded_threshold.label: Overcrowded threshold
overcrowded_threshold.definition: CPS labels a building overcrowded above 110 percent of adjusted ideal capacity; checked the same way.

median_nearest_underutilized.label: Median distance to the nearest other underutilized building
median_nearest_underutilized.definition: Median over the 265 underutilized buildings of the straight-line distance to the nearest other underutilized building.

underutilized_within_half_mile.label: Underutilized buildings within a half mile of another
underutilized_within_half_mile.definition: Underutilized buildings whose nearest other underutilized building is within half a mile, straight-line between building points.

underutilized_within_mile.label: Underutilized buildings within a mile of another
underutilized_within_mile.definition: Underutilized buildings whose nearest other underutilized building is within a mile, straight-line between building points.

median_distance_cdph_mhc.label: Median distance from an underutilized building to the nearest CDPH mental health center
median_distance_cdph_mhc.definition: Median over the 265 underutilized buildings of the straight-line distance to the nearest of the 7 centers in cdph_mental_health_centers.csv.

underutilized_records_within_mile_cdph_m.label: Underutilized school records within a mile of a CDPH mental health center
underutilized_records_within_mile_cdph_m.definition: Underutilized records (note 1's basis) whose building is within a mile of one of the seven centers; the same count on the building basis.

health_centers_operating.label: Health centers operating
health_centers_operating.definition: School-based health centers whose operational_status is operating.

health_centers_closed.label: Health centers closed or consolidated
health_centers_closed.definition: Centers whose operational_status is closed or closed_or_consolidated.

health_center_sponsors.label: Sponsors of operating centers
health_center_sponsors.definition: Distinct non-empty sponsor values among operating centers.

health_centers_in_building.label: Operating centers inside a school building
health_centers_in_building.definition: Operating centers whose setting is in_building.

centers_with_status.label: In-building centers whose host has a space-use status
centers_with_status.definition: Operating in-building centers whose host sid has a cps_status in utilization.csv.

centers_in_underutilized.label: Centers in buildings CPS scores underutilized
centers_in_underutilized.definition: Operating in-building centers whose host record is Underutilized.

underutilized_buildings_with_center.label: Underutilized buildings with a center
underutilized_buildings_with_center.definition: Distinct underutilized buildings hosting an operating in-building health center.

underutilized_buildings_no_center.label: Underutilized buildings with no center
underutilized_buildings_no_center.definition: The underutilized buildings less those with an operating in-building health center; both Spry records lack one.

centers_open_to_community.label: Operating centers open to the community
centers_open_to_community.definition: Operating centers whose open_to_public is true.

hosts_with_enrollment.label: Operating centers whose host school has a 20th-day count
hosts_with_enrollment.definition: Operating centers whose host sid has an enrollment_20th_day in utilization.csv.

host_median_enrollment.label: Median enrollment of those host schools
host_median_enrollment.definition: Median 20th-day enrollment over the 30 host schools with a count.

enrollment_ward.label: Enrollment, Laura S Ward Elementary School
enrollment_ward.definition: 20th-day enrollment of Laura S Ward Elementary School (sid 610133).

enrollment_johnson.label: Enrollment, James Weldon Johnson STEAM Elementary School
enrollment_johnson.definition: 20th-day enrollment of James Weldon Johnson STEAM Elementary School (sid 610274).

enrollment_orozco.label: Enrollment, Orozco Fine Arts & Sciences Elementary School
enrollment_orozco.definition: 20th-day enrollment of Orozco Fine Arts & Sciences Elementary School (sid 610329).

enrollment_dunbar.label: Enrollment, Paul Laurence Dunbar Career Academy High School
enrollment_dunbar.definition: 20th-day enrollment of Paul Laurence Dunbar Career Academy High School (sid 609676).

enrollment_beethoven.label: Enrollment, Ludwig Van Beethoven Elementary School
enrollment_beethoven.definition: 20th-day enrollment of Ludwig Van Beethoven Elementary School (sid 610237).

enrollment_gale.label: Enrollment, Stephen F Gale Elementary Community Academy
enrollment_gale.definition: 20th-day enrollment of Stephen F Gale Elementary Community Academy (sid 609933).
